flags.message: The event is labeled moment distribution, but the supplied October 5, 2026 latest-state snapshot and frozen context have null cutoff/cut_kind and include a CVSG issued that day, after the September 28 conference. This forecast properly uses the already-issued CVSG and is not a pristine first-distribution forecast. The CVSG-increment claim is already vacuous. No petition outcome was sought or observed; this note preserves the conditioning distinction for cohort interpretation.
